horoscopes.horoscope: Today you are going to have a great time, but only if you plan out the right things, says Ganesha. At the work place it will be business as usual with its highs and lows. But make some good plan for the evening and you will be surprised. Try something romantic. Mindblowing! It’s going to be one of your memorable nights ever. You will feel invited, ignited, and excited to experiment the thrill because it’s your partner who will run the show tonight. Full satisfaction is on the cards, feels Ganesha. You are suggested to avoid eating random stuff, instead, you should watch your diet properly as your stomach may not respond well to food that doesn’t suit you but craving to eat such things would be very high. Liquid diet may help maintain good health. Largely, today does not indicate that financial matters will be your priority. It’s neither bad day nor a very good day for money matters. Ganesha advises you to avoid speculative activities today. A stitch in time might not really save nine today, feels Ganesha. Don’t expect happy endings in the office, says Ganesha. Though you may be tempted to lose your temper, the situation can be handled only if you maintain your cool. Stop doing work when you are angry, warns Ganesha.

This is one of those days when you are likely to misplace and lose valuable things, particularly money. Ganesha urges you not to indulge heavy gambling or blind speculation I quest of easy money. Have no doubt that you are most likely to lose whatever you wager and incur huge losses. Be careful. Don’t get carried away by impulses. Exercise self restraint. Good fortune will smile on you sooner than you imagine. Be extremely careful while choosing your words, advises Ganesha, because they don’t just heal, but also hurt! Control your emotion if you are emotionally broken. You cannot expect magic just in a day. True love needs a serious commitment and a long-term dedication to become a legend, says Ganesha. You will feel like talking more and more than usual. You will find it difficult to control your thinking thus communication. However, talking too much may drain you faster, feels Ganesha. You should only talk about things which are very essential. You are likely to avoid thinking intensely about money matters in the latter part of the day. Ganesha feels, your commercial instincts are partly active today but you are far from being really alert. You might experience a panic attack today. However, don’t get all worked up already because things should be under your tight rein by the end of the day. Important meetings and discussions are in the pipeline. Managing the workload with a tough decision might be the biggest challenge.

You will be flooded with mental stress and worry today. You will have a hard time expressing your feelings and emotions today. You will feel nostalgic and will be flooded with memories, however, do not let your past cloud your present and your future, says Ganesha. Is your partner feeling bored tonight. Here’s a mysterious advice for you. Create a magical atmosphere and talk the occult or black magic with your loved one. Casting a spell on your sweetheart will surely bring him/her closer to you. This is an amazing way to grab your lover’s attention. Today your brain will be full of novel and practical ideas. But, before you implement your thoughts, consider all the pros and cons to make the right decision. You will be in a joyous mood as success is on the cards. In order to streamline your finances, you just need to have a single dimension. If you consider too many factors, you won’t be able to design a smart strategy to handle your money. The pressure of meeting deadlines will keep you glued to your cubicle today. Ganesha says that it will be a satisfying day in the office and though workload will get heavier, you will be able to achieve your deadline or target on time.

Today, your action will usher in incredible results, thanks to your forthright approach, foretells Ganesha. Later in the day, you may work on self-improvement and personality development. You may make some changes in your house. A change in your attitude is likely to come. You will return home with satisfaction and may surprise your partner by presenting a bouquet of white roses or cooking his or her favourite dish. You’ll be very realistic with your loved one today, feels Ganesha. He or she will certainly appreciate you. After a slow start in the morning, you shall physically reach office, but your mind will be wandering and planning a picnic. You shall prefer to leave early, and enjoy rest of the day with your friends or family. You will be willing to spend money on things that you really ‘want’. You will be carried away by your emotions to buy something. You will be indecisive in the first half, and the opposite later. A cool day in the office, says Ganesha. Your superiors will praise your professional conduct and even your peers and juniors will let you know that they admire and look up to you. The time and energy what you will invest today will fetch good result in the long run.

You will indulge in some important discussions with your family members and clarify some matters. You need to approach issues without prejudices. Do not judge without having all the facts at your disposal. You will spend the evening with your loved one, says Ganesha. Good news! Socialising is on the cards in the evening. You will forget your pains and worries and cherish all of your close relations. Time spent with your partner, family, friends will be an enjoyable one. Let down your hair and make this wonderful get-together a memorable one, says Ganesha. Expect to face some difficulties from your opponents in workplace. However, you should just control your temper, and remain focussed on your work. Try your best to overcome the hurdles and have faith in your abilities to surpass your competitors. Ganesha foresees you having some fiscal gains during the first half of the day but towards evening, you may have a big plan to spend money or there will be an unexpected financial expense. You will wake up cursing your bad luck, feeling that you are the most unfortunate person in the whole world! Hold your horses, says Ganesha. It doesn’t pay to be so pessimistic. Instead, focus on your targets and work on building your confidence. After all, luck alone can’t get you treasures!

Your creative talents will flourish today. Ganesha says you will be pleased with your possessions which you have carefully safeguarded for a long time. In the evening you may want to refurbish your house by making the necessary additions and subtractions. Words win hearts, words break hearts. Your relationship depends on what you say and how you say. Sweet words will really get your sweetheart closer to you. Bitter words will broaden the difference. Therefore, you need to be careful today, suggests Ganesha. Look forward to a bright and vibrant day. With your mind full of brilliant ideas and your body overflowing with energy, no task will appear to be daunting. Your excellent sense of humour will also keep you charged throughout the day. You will be able to discriminate between tangible and intangible financial gains today, feels Ganesha. You will realise that every penny invested does not necessarily come up with tangible financial return. Great! You will be able to meet your deadlines, foresees Ganesha. You might play a counselor at the office today and reach out to a large number of people and give free tips. Do not feel hurt when some people simply ignore you.

Ganesha says that you shall find your life more meaningful and fulfilling today because you will be able to indulge the artistic streak in your personality. In the evening, you may go out shopping, possibly for buying new things for your home. On the whole, an exciting day awaits you today. Stormy clouds may appear in love’s horizon, Ganesha doesn’t want you to worry. Even though short-term disagreements are likely to occur, you will remove the barriers by knowing your lover’s heart and appeasing him or her in ways more than one. You will be high spirits today, as the cosmos is going to be in your favour. Look forward to receive a number of opportunities, which shall lift your mood and make you feel happy. Health issues will now get resolved. You will be able to manage your money well. As stars are favouring you, there will hardly be any scope of complaining about money matters. As the day progresses, you will be increasingly busy with your work. A huge round of applause awaits you at the workplace today. Your colleagues and superiors will shower encomiums on you, which will motivate you to do even better. Your power, position, and prestige will glorify your fame and fortune, foresees Ganesha.

You are likely to have an urge to lead a more active and healthy lifestyle today. You will focus on improving your eating habits and consider your options for exercise, says Ganesha. On the work front, you will realise that learning to enjoy work is the best way of getting things done. Dawned with this realisation, you will feel complete and content. Ganesha’s grace will save you as far as personal life is concerned. With no clashes foreseen on the love front, harmony should fill your love life with bliss. You will enjoy many magical moments and the best of romantic nights will be yours, says Ganesha. You will get in the morning on the sluggish side and feel very low. This is because you have worked very hard during the last few days. Hence, you should definitely take a break in order to recharge your drained batteries. You may find something fishy in joint finances or in joint assets. You will be inspired to look deeply into accounting part or you may wish to find out where things are going wrong in your assets. Ganesha doesn’t foresee a great day as mental stress may take its toll on your peace of mind. Being short-tempered may damage an important relationship, feels Ganesha. Avoid losing your temper over trivial issues. Keep a tight rein on your mood swings!

You are likely to pull up your socks today shoulder the responsibilities that come your way. You may fall short of money due to some unexpected expenses. However, nothing can deter you from taking your sweetheart on a date. Have a lovely evening!. You need to be tactful even in your love life. Be attentive to your words. You may have to pay its price if you hurt the ego of your sweetheart. Avoiding conflicts with your partner may become a tough task for you, feels Ganesha. Taking decisions will not be easy today, as your mood may swing downwards. As far as possible, postpone tasks that are not important and just complete your urgent work. Learn to compromise with difficult people and adjust with tough circumstances. You will be following your own philosophy of life which will keep your head cool about money matters. Even if you have spent in the past and you are paying interest, it will not be a cause of concern. You may like to go through some rough patches in your profession. Be ready to face tough competition in the office today, advises Ganesha. Keep your eyes and ears open if you want to be on the safe side, advises Ganesha.

You are very close to your family members and they will lend a helping hand whenever you need them. They will help you climb the ladder of success and making the upward movement more comfortable. Happiness will come to you, however, you may have to pay a price for it. Don’t take the presence of your loved ones in your life for granted, advises Ganesha. Congratulations! Your lover will be bowled over by your magnetic personality. You will be able to capture your partner’s attention and communicate effectively. Both of you should have a gala time together. A great time will come if both of you understands each other’s space, foresees Ganesha. Remain focussed on your health today. This is particularly applicable for those who are prone to cold and cough. Keep away from chilled drinks and only have hot tea or coffee. This is the right time to improve your eating habits. Your routine and your daily habits will need certain changes if you really want to cut down on expenses. Opportunities to earn without hard work will be less so don’t expect stroke of luck today. Things may not appear crystal clear while you are in the decision-making process. Although work seems demanding, today’s the best day for analysis and data collection. Sorting out issues and prioritising work schedule will be the most important tasks to achieve.

You will be on the cloud nine today! With efforts getting recognised and rewarded, you are motivated to beat your on standards and raise the bar. Not that you have not worked hard, but at work, you may have to put in more efforts as your bosses expect you to be more efficient and productive. Keep yourself grounded, advises Ganesha. Except for a few emotional moments, your love life should be smooth today. You can sort out some communication problems with your partner. Fixing up a major issue may sound challenging but you will be ultimately able to stand by your partner once he or she is alone, feels Ganesha. Expect to remain in the pink of health till mid-day. However, as the day descends, health may be a cause of concern. So, do not waste your energy after unproductive activities and complete urgent tasks. Take the necessary medicines and relax. You should not wait for longer time for your stocks to appreciate, else it may not turn out to be ‘worth waiting’ situation for you. Ganesha feels that you must take a strong stand about speculative dealings. Busiest times are on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Meetings, discussions or presentations will occupy the majority of the day. Introducing minor changes in your office ambiance will be your top priority. However, avoid snubbing your primary responsibilities. Shuffling priorities will put everything in sync.

Today is a good day for conducting business and on the work-front, especially for those in higher management. You will find yourself attending important meetings or taking critical decisions. For students looking to pursue higher studies, now is a good time to get cracking. The later half of the day should see you communicate with friends or relatives living abroad, says Ganesha. Avoid postponing important matters related to heart today. Your partner’s emotional gestures will melt your heart and make you want to fall in love with him or her again. A wonderful day will be spent easily without knowing much, feels Ganesha. The workload may be too heavy today, but don’t tax your mind, and avoid straining your body beyond the possible limits. You need to take sufficient rest to replenish your drained energy and refresh your mind to regain peak fitness. You should try to maintain very good relations with your friends and business associates as they can give you some new assignments or can also show you the way to progress. A favourable day is on the cards. You will feel charged up emotionally and motivated to sharpen your skills by drawing inspiration from a famous personality or a legend, feels Ganesha who wants you to put more emphasis on correspondence.
